name: agenthands
description: Human mouse and keyboard input for AI browser agents, calibrated against measured human sessions rather than guessed constants
comment: Vendored from github:aeonmindai/agenthands v1.1.1 (2864fec). src, data, README, CALIBRATION and LICENSE are byte-identical to the tag; test/wheel.test.mjs and harness/wheel/measure.mjs differ by one line each, importing 'agenthands' instead of a relative path into dist/, so a clean clone needs no build to test. Bun resolves the 'bun' condition to src and runs it directly (worker, captcha, bun test). tsc reads the emitted dist/*.d.ts, because src is written for this package's own compiler options (no exactOptionalPropertyTypes, DOM lib) and a consumer compiling it under the repo base config would reject it; tsc --build emits dist first through the consumers' project references. Node resolves 'default' to the built dist/index.js, as upstream did.
